maya: Heads-up: TopoBank POC kickoff. Sales committed to a 6-week trial. Need engineering owners + success criteria. TL;DR: deliver VPC peering, model endpoint, example integration, SSO, and eval set. Proposed milestones: M1 (infra & peering) 1 week, M2 (endpoint + auth) 3 weeks, M3 (integration + eval) 6 weeks. @aditya @ken can you confirm?
aditya (eng-platform): I can own infra handoff + peering. Need network contacts from the customer's infra team and expected CIDR. Also will need a test dataset for eval.
ken (eng-runtime): I'll own endpoint + latency SLOs. Quick Q: are we serving full model or a distil variant? For latency goal we recommend a 4-bit quantized variant; will check compatibility.
sophia (solutions): Solutions will provide sample integration app and golden eval set. ETA for eval set: 3 business days. Also confirm success criteria: latency P50 < 300ms, false-positive rate on regression tests < 5%?
maya (sales): Yes to both. Customer also cares about token cost per session under $0.05. Add that as soft target.
eva (security): On SSO and data retention: need customer SCIM + SAML details. We'll require a security review before full VPC peering—can we schedule an onboarding call? @maya please share contact.
maya (sales): Shared contact: alice@topobank.com; CIDR: TBD. I'll schedule the call tomorrow 10am PT. Also adding milestone owners doc: M1 = aditya, M2 = ken, M3 = sophia.
aditya (eng-platform): For peering, we'll need an open ticket with cloud account IDs. I'll create infra ticket and assign to eng-infra. ETA to request: EOD tomorrow.
ken (eng-runtime): Working on model variant. If they want lowest latency, recommend redwood-davinci-quant-4b. If they need highest fidelity choose quant-7b. Need customer sample prompts to pick.
sophia (solutions): I'll upload sample prompts to the shared drive and link here in thread. Also can run initial eval locally and send results.
deploy-bot: Created ticket INFRA-412 for VPC peering request.
maya (sales): :thumbsup: Thanks all. Last ask: code review ping for the auth piece — @ken can you do a quick review by Friday so we can ship M2?
ken (eng-runtime): Yep, I'll pick up review today.
